report.title: ClinePass Models Monitoring

narrative.summary: **Weekly Monitoring Summary** No catalog, blend, or rate changes this week. Quality scores declined across the board for 17 models. Ten models dropped measurably, with the steepest declines from Qwen3.7 Max (29.5 → null), Kimi K3.1 Pro (55.1 → 46.0), MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46.3 → 29.9), GLM 5.3 (44.8 → 31.7), and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (45.1 → 32.5). Seven models now report no score: Solar Mini 4, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, Kimi K3, Qwen3.7 Max, Qwen3.7 Plus, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (free). No models improved; investigation into the missing scores is recommended.

warnings: measured rates differ from the dated reference table by more than 1.5x for: deepseek-v4.1-flash (0.50x of the reference), qwen3.7-plus (1.68x of the reference); the measured fit is published, so treat the reference table as stale for these models

plan.description: Cline Pass brings agentic coding to programmers around the world. Offering generous limits and reliable access to the most capable open-source models, so you can build with powerful agents without worrying about cost or availability.

included: Built for as many programmers as possible
